vault_locked: Vault locked or not initialized ({kind}). Unlock it in the console (padlock at the top) and run again.
item_not_found: item '{ref}' does not exist in the Password vault (see: nvault list)
field_empty: field '{field}' has no value in item {item_id} ({title}) (see: nvault list)
no_permission: user '{user}' does not have the vault.use permission (Access groups).
no_command: give the command after --  (e.g. run.py run -- npx wrangler deploy)
no_refs: warning: no nvault:// reference found; running the command without secrets.
vars_injected: [nvault] {count} vault variable(s): {names} (values masked in the output)
vault_empty: Password vault is empty. Add items in Inventory → Password vault.
description: Password vault secrets as environment variables (no file, masked output).
help_run: Run a command with the nvault:// references resolved
help_env_file: .env file with references (default: ./.env if it exists)
help_item: Export every field of the item (API key -> API_KEY)
help_list: Available items and references (never shows values)
help_check: Check the references in a .env (does not decrypt)
